articles.title: SAP SD Task Not Visible: Sales Document Missing from Unified Inbox
articles.error_signature: The approver cannot find sales document SD-6005 in the Unified Inbox.

articles.confirmed_root_cause: Missing SAP SD Backend Role — XX:BACKEND_SD:XX
